title: Charles's law
caption: At constant pressure, the volume of a gas is proportional to its absolute temperature. One mole of ideal gas at 1 atm occupies 22.4 dm³ at 273 K; extending the line back reaches zero volume at 0 K (−273 °C).
alt: Straight line of volume against temperature in kelvin through the origin, dashed below 200 K, passing 22.4 dm³ at 273 K.
description: Volume rises in proportion to kelvin temperature.
At 273 K, 22.4 dm³ for one mole at 1 atm.
Dashed extrapolation to the origin: zero volume at absolute zero.

checks.name: 1 mol at 1 atm and 273 K occupies 22.4 dm³ (V = nRT/p)
